backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access-controlled user profiles, feedback submission and admin review, plus a discussion system with threads and nested comments.
feature_evidence.json: Aggregated feature evidence file listing feature descriptions, associated files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries for numerous frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment config for setting an optional public site URL used for metadata generation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining custom OKLCH color variables, dark mode overrides, and global element styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template setting metadata, canonical/social tags, and loading the React app entrypoint.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app managing page routing, scroll-to-section behavior, and dynamic canonical/meta URL updates.
frontend/src/components/ContentSection.t: Simple wrapper component applying consistent prose styling to content sections.
frontend/src/components/discussions/Comm: Renders nested comment threads with timestamps and reply forms.
frontend/src/components/discussions/NewC: Form for posting comments or replies with validation and authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/discussions/NewT: Form for creating new discussion threads with title/content validation.
frontend/src/components/FeedbackForm.tsx: A feedback form component that validates input, submits feedback via a hook, and shows status toasts.
frontend/src/components/FredWelcomeIntro: Displays a welcome intro with topic cards and a button to start chatting with Fred.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button that handles Internet Identity login/logout states and errors.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Main site layout with header, navigation, mobile menu, admin-aware links, and footer.
frontend/src/config/site.ts: Utilities to compute site URLs, canonical URLs, and metadata configuration based on environment.
frontend/src/content/disclaimer.ts: Defines reusable disclaimer text constants for the site.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance, refreshing it on identity changes and invalidating related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: Provides hooks for fetching, creating, and updating discussion threads and comments via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity context, authentication flow, and identity persistence for the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines hooks to fetch user role, user profile, and feedback data from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSessionFlag.ts: Hook to store and persist a boolean flag in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitFeedback.ts: Provides a mutation hook to submit user feedback and refresh related queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup and custom CSS variables for light and dark theme styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with site mission details, address info, and feedback form.
frontend/src/pages/AdminFeedbackPage.tsx: Admin page to authenticate users, verify admin role, and display submitted feedback.
frontend/src/pages/BeginnerGuidePage.tsx: A beginner-focused guide page displaying instructional cards on elixir management, tower mechanics, and basic strategy using styled UI components.
frontend/src/pages/DeckTipsPage.tsx: Page presenting multiple example Clash Royale decks with archetypes, card lists, strengths, weaknesses, and gameplans.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Discussion forum page allowing users to view threads, read and post comments, and navigate between thread lists and individual threads.
frontend/src/pages/FredChatPage.tsx: Interactive chat interface for the Fred helper bot, handling message flow, typing simulation, session state, and displaying bot responses.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Homepage with a hero section, informational notice, official resource links, and optional navigation to an about-section explanation.
frontend/src/utils/fredDeckCardRoles.ts: Defines card role metadata and elixir costs used for deterministic deck analysis and lookup.
frontend/src/utils/fredDeckParser.ts: Parses user text into canonicalized deck lists using alias mappings and detects deck completeness.
frontend/src/utils/fredDeckReview.ts: Analyzes parsed decks to identify win conditions, archetype, elixir cost, strengths, weaknesses, and suggestions.
frontend/src/utils/fredKnowledgeBase.ts: Routes user messages through safety checks, deck parsing, and knowledge modules to generate deterministic responses.
frontend/src/utils/fredKnowledgeCards.ts: Provides predefined card-specific strategy explanations for the knowledge base.
frontend/src/utils/fredKnowledgeLadderAn: Defines progression-related topic entries for Fred, covering levels, resources, wild cards, trophy road, and Path of Legends.
frontend/src/utils/fredKnowledgeMatchups: Provides matchup guidance topics for common Clash Royale win conditions with defensive tips and counters.
frontend/src/utils/fredKnowledgeTopics.t: Defines the TopicDefinition interface and supplies core mechanics and archetype knowledge topics used by Fred.
frontend/src/utils/fredMatcher.ts: Implements text normalization, tokenization, synonym expansion, and scoring logic to match user queries to topics.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config defining dark mode, content paths, typography and animation plugins, and extensive theme extensions for colors, fonts, shadows, and keyframes.
project_state.json: JSON describing the project’s state, including versioning, goals, architectural notes, known issues, and the list of existing implemented features.
